Hi Michael —

Thanks for the quick intro. We're starting PO setup for BlueHarbor Logistics and need to collect tax and signer evidence before procurement can issue a PO. To keep things moving, can you please: 

- Confirm whether BlueHarbor is a US taxpayer or foreign entity (you can reply with country of incorporation).
- Complete and return the correct tax form: W-9 (US) or W-8BEN-E (foreign). If W-8BEN-E, please indicate whether you're claiming any U.S. treaty benefits.
- Provide the name and title of the person who will sign invoices/agreements and confirm they are an authorized signatory on company records. If the signer is not listed on the certificate of incorporation, a signed delegation of authority on company letterhead (and notarized if possible) will be required.
- Provide official tax identifier (TIN or local equivalent) and a bank remit letter for ACH setup.

I've attached our PO template to show the billing fields we need (redwood_po_template.docx). Once we have the tax form and signatory evidence we can route to finance for PO issuance — typical lead time is 2 business days after docs clear.

Please attach docs as PDFs to this thread. If any paperwork requires a legal contact from our side, loop in Laura (cc'd).

Thanks — appreciate the help getting this across the finish line.

—Stephanie

Hi Michael / Stephanie —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments. A couple of tax-validation items from Redwood Tax/Finance to confirm before we mark the W-8BEN-E as complete: 

1) On the W-8BEN-E we need an explicit indication that BlueHarbor is a corporation and the chapter 4 status is correctly selected. I can walk through the relevant boxes if you want; in many cases for service vendors the box for 'Corporation' plus 'not claiming treaty benefits' is sufficient.

2) Please provide the BlueHarbor Irish Tax Reference (TIN) as recorded with the Irish Revenue Commissioners — we use that to cross-check with our compliance tooling. A single line (e.g., IE1234567A) in the body of the reply is fine if you prefer not to include another doc.

3) Regarding signer authority: a delegation of authority on company letterhead is acceptable, but Redwood procurement requires either the delegation AND a board resolution, OR a notarized delegation if a board resolution isn't available. Notarization is the faster path from our side.

4) For PO issuance: issuing to BlueHarbor Logistics Ltd is fine — please confirm the legal name and the exact remit address that should appear on the PO and invoices. Also confirm whether you require a consolidated PO for the parent or individual POs per country (we typically issue one PO per legal entity).

If you can confirm items 1–4 we can clear the docs and I will kick the PO to finance.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Tax Counsel, Redwood Inference
